title: 주민센터에서 전입신고하기: 이사 왔는데 뭐가 필요해요?
objective: You can tell a 주민센터 clerk you have moved and ask what you need with -(으)려면.
summary: A resident reports a new address at a community service center.
setting: A counter at a local community service center (주민센터) on a weekday morning.

task.title: Use the counter expressions
task.line: Read each item, then write the Korean word, form, or sentence that fits.

words.meaning: a report that you have moved into a new address
words.exampleMeaning: I've been busy, so I haven't reported my move yet.
I left my ID at home.

words.meaning: box or space on a form
to be handled, to be processed (a request or document)
words.exampleMeaning: The paperwork has already been processed.

words.meaning: copy of your resident registration (shows your address and household)
words.exampleMeaning: Your family members' names also appear on the 등본.
I got a 등본 to hand in at the bank.
Take a number ticket and wait.

words.meaning: if you want to ~ / to ~ (asking or telling what is needed for a goal)
words.exampleMeaning: To get a passport, you need a photo.

dialogue.korean: 다음 분, 이쪽으로 오세요. 무슨 일로 오셨어요?
dialogue.meaning: Next, please come this way. What can I help you with?

dialogue.korean: 지난주에 이 동네로 이사했거든요. 전입신고를 하려면 어떻게 해야 돼요?
dialogue.meaning: I moved to this neighborhood last week. What do I need to do to report my move?

dialogue.korean: 먼저 이 전입신고서를 써 주세요. 신분증도 보여 주시고요.
dialogue.meaning: First, please fill out this move-in report form. And please show me your ID too.

dialogue.korean: 다 썼어요. 혹시 오늘 바로 처리돼요?
dialogue.meaning: I'm done. Will it be processed today, by any chance?

dialogue.korean: 네, 다 됐습니다. 새 주소를 확인하시려면 등본을 한 통 떼 보세요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, it's all done. If you want to check your new address, get a copy of your resident registration.

exercises: Fill in the blank with -(으)려면 (use 가다): 주민센터에 ____ 몇 번 버스를 타야 돼요?
Join the two parts with -(으)려면: ① 새 휴대폰을 사다 / 돈을 더 모아야 해요 ② 번호표를 뽑다 / 저 기계로 가세요
Fill in each blank with a word from the box [칸 / 신분증 / 처리]: ① 이 ____에는 아무것도 쓰지 마세요. ② ____이 없으면 서류를 뗄 수 없어요. ③ 신청은 내일까지 ____될 거예요.
Answer in Korean: The clerk asks you, "무슨 일로 오셨어요?" You moved here last week and want to report your new address.
Read the dialogue and answer in Korean: What does the visitor have to do first?
answers: ① 새 휴대폰을 사려면 돈을 더 모아야 해요. ② 번호표를 뽑으려면 저 기계로 가세요.
① 칸 ② 신분증 ③ 처리
이사해서 전입신고를 하러 왔어요. (지난주에 이사했거든요. 전입신고를 하려면 어떻게 해야 돼요?)
전입신고서를 써야 해요. (신고서를 먼저 써야 해요.)
